name: How long does it take to install a gas line for a new range?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install a gas line for a new range?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required to install a gas line for a new range can vary, but most standard installations are completed within a few hours. Factors influencing the duration include the complexity of the routing, whether existing plumbing needs to be moved, and if any unexpected issues arise. A professional plumber will be able to provide a more precise time estimate after an initial assessment of your home and the specific installation requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most standard gas line installations for a range take a few hours. Time can vary based on complexity and home layout.
